tldr: 週五（8/7）台股獲利了結下跌170點失守季線，台積電守住 2,370 元關卡。
台積電上修 2026 全年營收成長至近三成，先進製程佔晶圓銷售 74%，AI 動能持續增強。
金管會放寬壽險金控獲利公布期限，並公布本國銀行最新逾放情形。
亞洲資產管理中心政策提前達標，高資產與 ETF 資金動能延續。

items.title_zh: 台股下跌170點失守季線 台積電守住2,370元
items.title_en: Taiex falls 170 points below quarterly line as TSMC holds NT$2,370
items.summary_zh: 台股週五（8/7）開高走低，市場獲利了結賣壓湧現，加權指數盤中由紅翻黑，終場下跌170.79點、失守季線。台積電逆勢收漲5元，守住2,370元關卡，成為指數重要支撐；顯示在指數回檔之際，AI 權值龍頭買盤仍為盤面提供定心作用。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index opened higher but reversed on Friday (Aug 7), shedding 170.79 points and slipping under its quarterly moving average as investors locked in gains after a strong run. TSMC bucked the softness, adding NT$5 to defend the NT$2,370 level, cushioning the broader retreat and signaling that AI-leader demand continues to anchor sentiment despite the index-level pullback.

items.title_zh: 券商晨訊：高檔換手 聚焦AI與財報亮點
items.title_en: Brokerage morning notes flag high-level churn and AI leaders
items.summary_zh: 週五券商晨訊將盤勢定調為「高檔換手」防禦戰，提醒指數走高後宜留意調節賣壓。分析師點名 AI 相關零組件與財報亮眼個股為近期主要動能，並提醒類股輪動與獲利了結恐限制上檔空間，短線須等台積電財測等新催化劑重設下半年預期。
items.summary_en: Friday's brokerage strategy briefings framed the session as a "high-level handover" battle, urging defensive positioning after the index's climb. Analysts pointed to AI-related components and select earnings winners as the market's near-term drivers, while cautioning that rotation and profit-taking could cap upside until fresh catalysts—chiefly TSMC's guidance signals—reset expectations for the second half.

items.title_zh: 台積電上調2026展望 AI營收CAGR上看六成
items.title_en: TSMC raises 2026 outlook as AI revenue CAGR nears 60%
items.summary_zh: 台積電上修 2026 全年營收成長至近三成，管理階層預估 2024～2029 年 AI 相關營收複合年成長率（CAGR）近 60%。先進製程銷售金額已佔整體晶圓銷售 74%，公司並將全年資本支出上修至 600～640 億美元，凸顯 AI 需求重塑其長期獲利能力與擴產藍圖。
items.summary_en: TSMC lifted its 2026 view toward roughly 30% full-year revenue growth, with management guiding AI-related revenue to a near-60% compound annual growth rate through 2029. Advanced-node sales now account for 74% of total wafer revenue, and the foundry raised full-year capex to US$60–64 billion—underscoring how AI demand is reshaping its long-term earnings power and capacity roadmap.

items.title_zh: AI下一波轉向推論與機器人 供應鏈受惠
items.title_en: Next AI wave shifts to inference and robotics, lifting supply chain
items.summary_zh: 業界指出 AI 已從大型模型訓練逐步轉向 AI 推論、代理式 AI 及實體 AI（機器人），帶動半導體需求擴散。台灣今年半導體產值預估達 8.45 兆元、年增 29.5%，再創新高；台積電同步將 CoWoS 先進封裝產能擴充約四倍至每月 12～14 萬片，使下一波成長集中於封裝與推論相關零組件。
items.summary_en: Industry watchers say AI is moving from large-model training toward inference, agentic AI and physical AI (robotics), broadening semiconductor demand. Taiwan's 2026 chip output is projected at NT$8.45 trillion, up 29.5% to a record, while TSMC ramps CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity roughly fourfold toward 120,000–140,000 wafers a month—concentrating the next leg of growth in packaging and inference-related components.

items.title_zh: 11家有保險業務金控 獲利可延至15日公布
items.title_en: Insurance-holding financials get later earnings-disclosure deadline
items.summary_zh: 主管機關同意 11 家具保險業務的金控，2026 年獲利公布時程可延後至每月 15 日，反映在新會計與清償能力規範下，整併壽險損益的複雜度提高。此舉讓壽險業有更充裕時間完成評價作業，也統一了以保險為主體之大型金控今年的獲利揭露時程。
items.summary_en: Regulators are allowing the 11 financial holding companies with insurance operations to disclose their profits later—extended to the 15th—reflecting the added complexity of consolidating insurance results under evolving accounting and solvency rules. The move gives insurers more time to finalize valuations, and standardizes the disclosure calendar for the sector's largest, insurance-heavy holding groups this year.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布本國銀行逾放與壽險商品資訊
items.title_en: FSC publishes banks' overdue-loan data and insurer product updates
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布 115 年 6 月底本國銀行逾期放款情形，並揭露壽險公司具外溢效果保險商品及實物給付保險商品相關資訊，屬例行監理揭露。逾放比維持穩定，強化外界對銀行資產品質的信心；壽險商品揭露則凸顯健康外溢型保單在業者商品組合中角色日益吃重。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission released end-June figures on domestic banks' non-performing loans and details on life insurers' health-linked and in-kind benefit products, part of routine supervisory disclosure. Stable overdue-loan ratios reinforce confidence in banks' asset quality, while the insurer disclosures spotlight the growing role of wellness-linked policies in the sector's product mix.

items.title_zh: 亞洲資產管理中心提前達標 高資產成引擎
items.title_en: Asset-management-hub push hits two-year AUM target early
items.summary_zh: 台灣自 2024 年推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，資產管理規模快速擴大，於 2025 年底提前達成兩年目標，高資產財富管理為重要成長引擎。延續 2020 年放寬銀行服務資產達 1 億元以上客戶的規範，此趨勢正加深境內私人銀行、信託與結構型商品對高資產客戶的服務深度。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Asian Asset Management Center policy, launched in 2024, saw assets under management expand rapidly and reach its two-year target ahead of schedule by end-2025, with high-net-worth wealth management a key growth engine. Building on 2020 rules that let banks serve clients with NT$100 million-plus in assets, the trend is deepening onshore private-banking, trust and structured-product offerings for wealthy investors.

items.title_en: Dividend ETFs stay core to retail savers' 2026 portfolios
items.summary_zh: 0050、00919、00878 等高息與市值型 ETF，2026 年持續位居台灣存股族最愛排行前列，以低成本、分散風險與透明追蹤指數見長。這些商品資金穩定流入，反映散戶朝被動、收益導向配置的結構性轉變，使 ETF 成為與銀行、私銀財管方案並列的主流配置工具。
items.summary_en: Popular income ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 continue to top Taiwanese savers' holdings in 2026, prized for low cost, diversification and transparent index tracking. Steady inflows into these dividend and market-cap products reflect a structural shift toward passive, income-oriented allocation among retail investors—reinforcing ETFs as a mainstream building block alongside bank and private-bank wealth solutions.
